description: This file contains security utility functions for SuiteCRM, including access checking, role querying, and client IP retrieval.

classes.name: TabController
classes.description: Controller class for managing module tabs in user interface.

classes.name: Roles
classes.description: Class representing user roles and associated permissions.

methods.name: query_module_access_list
methods.description: Retrieves the list of modules a user has access to via TabController.

methods.name: query_user_has_roles
methods.description: Checks if a user has any roles assigned by counting role associations.

methods.name: get_user_allowed_modules
methods.description: Returns modules permitted for a specific user based on their roles.

methods.name: get_user_disallowed_modules
methods.description: Returns modules disallowed for a user, given allowed modules.

methods.name: query_client_ip
methods.description: Attempts to determine the client's IP address from server variables.

methods.name: get_val_array
methods.description: Returns an array mapping each value to itself, effectively extracting keys.
